artworks.title: Der Gesprengte und der Bibliotheke Thurm von Heidelberger Schloß (The Exploded Tower and the Library of Heidelberg Castle)
artworks.medium: lithograph with tone plate on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a stone tower in a state of disrepair. The tower is off-center, dominating the scene. The setting seems historical, with ruins and rocky arches visible. The artwork is detailed, resembling traditional etching with fine lines. It is colored in sepia tones. Trees surround the tower, with two figures present near it. Another tower can be seen in the distance. The sky is depicted with a soft gradient and textured clouds.

artworks.title: Lovers
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of jagged and swirling lines creating an intricate and abstract pattern. In the center, the lines intertwine to suggest the shapes of two figures in close proximity. The chaotic network of lines in the background creates a texture that might evoke foliage or rippling water. Contrasts between light and dark areas fill the composition with a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Seated Nude
artworks.description: The image is a black and white print depicting a stylized nude female figure. The person is shown sitting with legs bent and one arm across the chest. The face features abstract lines for eyes and mouth, with dark hair above the head. The figure is nude with no clothing or accessories. The background includes stylized foliage or patterns. The print is centered with the artist's signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Marseille, Steamship in the Harbor (Marseille, Dampfer im Hafen)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene in a black and white woodcut style. The view is slightly elevated, capturing the busy area. Small boats with figures are depicted in the foreground, with bold lines and cross-hatching defining their shapes. In the background, a larger ship is present, appearing to lean slightly. The skyline of the harbor is visible with various structures filling the upper section. The composition is dynamic, with energetic brushwork and sharp angles creating texture. The color palette is monochrome, using black ink on white paper.

artworks.title: Seated Female
artworks.description: The black and white linocut artwork depicts a person in a seated position, facing slightly to the right, with a stylized, abstract facial features and short hair. The figure is shown from the waist up without clothing, set against a background filled with bold, jagged patterns.

artworks.title: The Suffering Ones
artworks.medium: color lithograph printed in black, yellow, pink, green and blue on wove light grey paper
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling lines and angular shapes creating an abstract scene. In the center, a figure with arms raised is shown, possibly connected to a pole or tree. On the left, there is a swirling mass resembling a round object, akin to a luminous moon. The image includes busy patterns reminiscent of a forest or jungle setting with shapes resembling leaves and fronds. Towards the lower part, a small figure or object is seen.

artworks.title: Aufzug der Polizei von Bagdad
artworks.description: The image displays intersecting lines and shapes in a textured surface. The composition contains elongated, curving lines and fragmented figures that resemble horses and riders in motion. The strokes create a chaotic energy, suggesting a crowded street or marketplace.

artworks.title: Two Lions (Zwei Löwen)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two animals standing side by side. The animals are depicted using bold, black lines on a light beige background. The style is simple and expressive, with minimal detail, capturing the essence of the forms rather than precise realism. The positioning of the lines suggests movement and interaction between the two creatures. Vertical lines in the background may represent a fence or enclosure. The drawing has a sketch-like quality, focusing on the dynamic relationship between the animals rather than intricate detail.

artworks.title: The Tightrope Walker (Die Seiltänzerin)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person balancing on a tightrope, leaning slightly and holding a large circular object with one hand. They have short hair, defined facial features, and are dressed in a dark sleeveless outfit. In the background, there is a crowd of people.

artworks.title: Spieler (Stevenson) [Gambler (Stevenson)]
artworks.description: The image features intersecting lines and distorted shapes forming an abstract scene in a confined space. The lines converge to create figures resembling people with exaggerated features. One figure leans over a table with scattered items that resemble playing cards. The figures have elongated limbs and angular forms that merge with swirling patterns around them.

artworks.title: Tom Mix I
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures near the center, drawn in a sketch-like style. The viewpoint is flat, allowing easy engagement with the figures. The horizon is high, with hills and mountains in the background. The line work emphasizes form and outline, using a grayscale color palette. In the distance, the landscape continues with texture and shading, providing depth and continuity beyond the figures.

artworks.title: Markt (Market)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract human figures in different poses. The lines are bold and expressive with a cartoonish effect. The figures have exaggerated facial features and simple outlines. The background shows a minimal urban landscape. The image has a raw, sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (Selbstporträt)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The person is facing partially towards the viewer with their head turned slightly to one side. Features such as the eyes, nose, and lips are emphasized with angular lines and sharp contours. The person's short, receding hair is visible, and they are wearing a high-collared garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The background is plain, with a lightly sketched texture.

artworks.title: Hindu Village (Das Hindudorf)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lively, bustling scene with many figures engaged in various activities. There is an elephant in the center, surrounded by trees and structures. The figures are depicted with expressive, sketchy lines, engaging in actions like dancing or participating in a ceremony. The sketch-like lines give the drawing a dynamic and energetic quality.

artworks.title: Hyde Park Rider, THE BONES ARE ALL INSIDE!!! (ROTTEN-ROW LONDON 1931)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses with riders in a park setting. It features multiple horses being ridden along a dirt or grassy path, bordered by trees. The horses and their riders are depicted with linear detail, suggesting motion and posture. The background includes lines representing terrain and natural surroundings, all in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Uble Street (Uble Strasse)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract, crowded street scene. The drawing includes various figures in a bustling urban environment, depicted with expressive, exaggerated features and gestures. Lines are cross-hatched and scribbled to create texture and depth. The background features architectural elements like buildings and possibly windows that fade in and out of focus. The use of line work gives a rough, dynamic quality to the scene, emphasizing the lively nature of the crowd. Shapes are simplified, and the overall composition suggests an interaction among figures and the surroundings.

artworks.title: Die Komponistin Sonia Friedman (The Composer Sonia Friedman)
artworks.description: The image depicts a monochrome print of a person with only the upper half of their body visible. They are positioned in a three-quarter view, facing to the left, with their head bowed down and their hands resting on a surface in front of them. The person has prominent, angular facial features with a pronounced nose and downcast eyes, framed by straight, dark hair that falls to the sides of their face. They are wearing a dark garment with long sleeves, which covers most of their body, and the hands are detailed with dark nails. There are no visible elements of jewelry or objects held. The background is an abstract pattern of lines and blocks.

artworks.title: Sidi Heckel
artworks.description: The image features a close-up view of a person's face and upper shoulders, with prominent facial features including large, wide eyes and slightly parted lips. The individual is positioned facing forward with wavy hair and wearing a high-neck, dark-colored garment. The background consists of abstract, linear patterns with dots and a small, butterfly-like figure in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Mit dem Selbstmord Spielen (Playing with Suicide)
artworks.medium: colored woodcut printed in blue, hand-colored with red gouache, on wove yellow paper
artworks.description: This image features bold, jagged lines and shapes intersecting across a yellow backdrop. The dark, irregular lines and patches create an dynamic composition. The overlapping curves and angular elements suggest limbs and faces.

artworks.title: Eavesdropping
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract faces. The artwork features a collection of five abstract faces set against a dark background. Each face has sharp, angular features, prominent noses, and downturned eyes. The faces are arranged in a clustered formation, creating a sense of depth and overlapping, with three faces more prominent and two subtly integrated into the background. The contrast between the light ivory faces and the deep black space surrounding them enhances the emotional impact of the image.

artworks.title: Listening
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove light orange paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the shoulders up. The person is facing slightly to the right with a calm expression, downcast eyes, defined facial features, and short hair. They are depicted in a painterly style and are wearing clothing with a high collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. In the background, abstract shapes and forms suggest an artistic setting with hints of a tree-like shapes. The composition is monochromatic with black strokes on a light background.

artworks.title: The Young Bride (Sonia Gramatté) [Bräutliches Mädchen (Sonia Gramatté)]
artworks.medium: color lithograph in black, blue, red, and yellow
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 67.5 × 53.2 cm (26 9/16 × 20 15/16 in.) [irregular]
image: 38 × 49 cm (14 15/16 × 19 5/16 in.) [irregular]

artworks.title: Barracks (Kaserne)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a house or series of buildings along the horizon line, under a sun in the sky. The structures are depicted with bold black lines and simple details like arched windows and doors. In the foreground, there are swirling lines indicating a textured landscape leading to the buildings, with a dark structure to the left. The artwork is in black and gray tones, resembling an etching or drypoint technique with varying stroke intensity and direction.
